business_description.value: Bitrise provides a mobile DevOps platform for building, testing, deploying, and releasing iOS and Android applications, including managed CI/CD, build infrastructure, release management, build caching, and CodePush services.

cloud_signals.value: Bitrise operates a managed cloud platform for mobile application builds.
Bitrise provides dedicated build execution environments that can run in customer cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
Bitrise operates build infrastructure involving virtual machines, dynamic scaling, Google Cloud for Linux builds, and a large Mac cloud for iOS builds.
The platform includes cloud-based CI/CD, build caching, release management, and application deployment capabilities.
